messages.subject: three equals indicator intercepts?
parts:
This is not working; 

r01 ~ equal("r02~1")*1 + equal("r03~1")*1

How could I fix these three intercepts to be equal?

Thanks!

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: three equals indicator intercepts?
parts:
The easiest way to do this is to specify the same label for each intercept:

r01 ~ a*1
r02 ~ a*1
r03 ~ a*`1

(where a is a label and all parameters with the same label are constrained to equality)
